newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid cargo volume down in October, ahaead in year.
newsitem.headline: Madrid cargo volume down in October, ahaead in year.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Madrid's Barajas airport slipped six percent in volume terms in October compared with the same month last year to 19,886 tonnes, the airport authority said.
The accumulated total is still 2.5 percent ahead of 1995 at 194,301 tonnes, with domestic traffic up 4.4 percent and international traffic only 1.7 percent higher.
Charter traffic, both national and international, was the only category to show modest growth in the month.
International cargo accounted for 14,223 tonnes and domestic for 5,663 of the total.
Passenger numbers rose by just over eight percent. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
